Reviewed early boot entry separation and failure recovery, shared Fraunces/Hanken roles and indeterminate river activity. The boot paints before dynamically importing main; main handoff releases HTML animation, app readiness remains free to interrupt all motion. Entry failure shows a focusable reload control. The budget includes eager app static closure via generated manifest rather than counting only the small visual kernel; measured startup growth and headroom are owned in the commit.

The approved splash font choice remains scoped to Station startup and does not finalize the broader wordmark OPEN decision.
